title: How we can work together.
intro: Consulting and training services focus on helping teams design better architectures, improve code quality, and ship mobile apps more confidently.
items: Architecture and codebase reviews for Android, iOS, and Flutter apps.
Mentoring developers on state management, testing, and CI/CD.
Product and technical guidance for founders building their first MVP.
Workshops and short training programs for in‑house teams.
closing: A typical engagement starts with a short discovery call to understand your product, codebase, and goals.
